answers.stem_only: The group uses only EC2 status checks by default, so it ignores the target group's verdict. Turn on the ELB health check type for the Auto Scaling group so instances the load balancer marks unhealthy are replaced automatically; no custom code needed.

A group created with the CLI gets a health check grace period of 0, so ELB health checks fail before the app is ready and the instance is replaced. Set the health check grace period above the ~4 minute startup time; ELB health checks stay on so later failures are still replaced.

The app is stateful in memory and cannot run as several copies, so horizontal scaling is out. Scale vertically: move to a larger instance type (a short stop/start), and resize again as the load grows.
